### `get_sector_stalker`

**Sector Stalker** — `GET /analysis/stalker/sector` · cache: `realtime`

```rust
client.analysis().get_sector_stalker(params: &SectorStalkerParams).await -> Result<SectorStalkerResponse, InvezgoError>
```

Get sectoral index or stock price movement data within a specific time range.

| Parameter | In | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `from` | query | String | yes |  | Tanggal awal periode (`YYYY-MM-DD`). Harus lebih kecil atau sama dengan `to`, dengan rentang maksimal 730 hari. |
| `to` | query | String | yes |  | Tanggal akhir periode (`YYYY-MM-DD`). Harus lebih besar atau sama dengan `from`. |
| `base` | query | SectorStalkerBase: `Composite` = `COMPOSITE`, `Syariah` = `SYARIAH`, `Idxenergy` = `IDXENERGY`, `Idxbasic` = `IDXBASIC`, `Idxindust` = `IDXINDUST`, `Idxnoncyc` = `IDXNONCYC`, `Idxcyclic` = `IDXCYCLIC`, `Idxhealth` = `IDXHEALTH`, `Idxfinance` = `IDXFINANCE`, `Idxpropert` = `IDXPROPERT`, `Idxtechno` = `IDXTECHNO`, `Idxinfra` = `IDXINFRA`, `Idxtrans` = `IDXTRANS` | no | `COMPOSITE` | Indeks acuan. `COMPOSITE` (IHSG) menampilkan rotasi antar sektor, sedangkan `SYARIAH` (saham syariah, dibandingkan dengan indeks ISSI) atau indeks sektoral IDX-IC (`IDXENERGY`, `IDXFINANCE`, dst.) menampilkan rotasi saham anggota kategori tersebut. `ISSI` diterima sebagai alias `SYARIAH`. Wajib huruf kapital. |
| `limit` | query | i64 | no |  | Jumlah saham maksimal yang ditampilkan. Hanya berlaku jika `base` bukan `COMPOSITE`. |
| `filter` | query | String | no |  | Pencarian saham berdasarkan sebagian kode atau nama, mis. `BB` atau `BANK`. Hanya berlaku jika `base` bukan `COMPOSITE`. |
| `filter_column` | query | SectorStalkerFilterColumn: `Change` = `change`, `Value` = `value`, `Volume` = `volume`, `Foreign` = `foreign`, `Freq` = `freq`, `Bdm` = `bdm`, `Ritel` = `ritel`, `Ratio` = `ratio`, `Open` = `open`, `High` = `high`, `Low` = `low`, `Close` = `close` | no |  | Kolom yang difilter: `change` = perubahan harga (%), `value` = nilai transaksi, `volume` = volume, `foreign` = net asing, `freq` = frekuensi, `bdm` = aliran dana bandar, `ritel` = aliran dana ritel, `ratio` = rasio, `open`/`high`/`low`/`close` = harga OHLC. Filter aktif hanya jika `filter_column`, `filter_operator`, dan `filter_value` dikirim bersamaan. |
| `filter_operator` | query | SectorStalkerFilterOperator: `Lt` = `<`, `Gt` = `>`, `Eq` = `=`, `Gte` = `>=`, `Lte` = `<=`, `Ne` = `!=` | no |  | Operator pembanding untuk filter. Contoh: `filter_column=change&filter_operator=>&filter_value=5` menampilkan saham yang naik lebih dari 5%. |
| `filter_value` | query | f64 | no |  | Nilai pembanding untuk filter. Mendukung bilangan desimal dan negatif, mis. `5` atau `-2.5`. |

Returns: `SectorStalkerResponse`.

## batch

Batch endpoints: fetch many stocks in one request (counted as 1 request).

### `get_order_book`

**Batch Stock Order Book** — `GET /batch/order-book/{code}` · cache: `realtime`

```rust
client.batch().get_order_book(code: &str, params: Option<&BatchOrderBookParams>).await -> Result<Vec<BatchOrderBookItem>, InvezgoError>
```

Get order book data for multiple stocks at once in a single request (up to 10 codes on the MAX plan, 25 on the ELITE plan).

| Parameter | In | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `code` | path | &str | yes |  | Daftar kode saham yang dipisahkan `\|` atau koma, mis. `BBCA\|GOTO\|TLKM`. Maksimal 10 kode (paket MAX) atau 25 kode (paket ELITE) per request. |
| `market` | query | BatchOrderBookMarket: `Rg` = `RG`, `Ng` = `NG`, `Tn` = `TN` | no | `RG` | Jenis pasar: `RG` = Pasar Reguler, `NG` = Pasar Negosiasi, `TN` = Pasar Tunai. Gunakan `RG` untuk analisis pergerakan harga pada umumnya. Default `RG` bila tidak diisi. |
| `date` | query | String | no |  | Tanggal order book historis (`YYYY-MM-DD`), data tersedia mulai `2026-03-25`. Kirim bersama `time`; kosongkan keduanya untuk data realtime. |
| `time` | query | String | no |  | Jam order book dalam WIB, format `HH:mm` dengan presisi menit. Kirim bersama `date`. |

Returns: `Vec<BatchOrderBookItem>`.

### `get_intraday_data`

**Batch Stock Intraday Data** — `GET /batch/intraday-data/{code}` · cache: `realtime`

```rust
client.batch().get_intraday_data(code: &str, params: Option<&BatchIntradayDataParams>).await -> Result<Vec<BatchIntradayDataItem>, InvezgoError>
```

Get compact intraday price data for multiple stocks at once in a single request (up to 10 codes on the MAX plan, 25 on the ELITE plan).

| Parameter | In | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `code` | path | &str | yes |  | Daftar kode saham yang dipisahkan `\|` atau koma, mis. `BBCA\|GOTO\|TLKM`. Maksimal 10 kode (paket MAX) atau 25 kode (paket ELITE) per request. |
| `market` | query | BatchIntradayDataMarket: `Rg` = `RG`, `Ng` = `NG`, `Tn` = `TN` | no | `RG` | Jenis pasar: `RG` = Pasar Reguler, `NG` = Pasar Negosiasi, `TN` = Pasar Tunai. Gunakan `RG` untuk analisis pergerakan harga pada umumnya. Default `RG` bila tidak diisi. |
| `date` | query | String | no |  | Tanggal data historis (`YYYY-MM-DD`). Kosongkan untuk data realtime hari ini. |

Returns: `Vec<BatchIntradayDataItem>`.

### `get_intraday_index`

**Batch Index Intraday Data** — `GET /batch/intraday-index/{code}` · cache: `realtime`

## journals

Personal trading journal transactions.

### `add`

**Add Journal Transaction** — `POST /journals` · cache: `none`

```rust
client.journals().add(body: &AddJournalRequest).await -> Result<JournalsAddResponse, InvezgoError>
```

Add one BUY or SELL transaction to the user's journal and update the portfolio. A BUY adds lots and recalculates the average price (incl. buy fee) for the stock code + broker pair; a SELL reduces lots and records a realized trade (profit/loss) shown in `GET /trades`.

Body: `AddJournalRequest`. Returns: `JournalsAddResponse`.

### `list`

**Journal Transaction List** — `GET /journals` · cache: `default`

```rust
client.journals().list(params: &JournalsListParams).await -> Result<Vec<JournalsListItem>, InvezgoError>
```

Get the user's journal transactions (BUY/SELL) dated between `from` and `to` (inclusive), newest first.

| Parameter | In | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `from` | query | String | yes |  | Tanggal awal periode (`YYYY-MM-DD`). |
| `to` | query | String | yes |  | Tanggal akhir periode (`YYYY-MM-DD`). Harus lebih besar atau sama dengan `from`. |

Returns: `Vec<JournalsListItem>`.

### `delete`

**Delete Journal Transactions** — `DELETE /journals` · cache: `none`

```rust
client.journals().delete(body: &DeleteIdsRequest).await -> Result<JournalsDeleteResponse, InvezgoError>
```

Delete one or more journal transactions by ID (body `{"id": ["<id>", ...]}`) and reverse their effect on the portfolio: deleting a BUY reduces the position's lots, deleting a SELL returns the lots to the position and removes the related realized trade.

Body: `DeleteIdsRequest`. Returns: `JournalsDeleteResponse`.

### `get_summary`

**Journal Summary** — `GET /journals/summary` · cache: `default`

```rust
client.journals().get_summary(params: &JournalsSummaryParams).await -> Result<JournalsSummaryResponse, InvezgoError>
```

Get a summary of the user's journal transactions dated between `from` and `to` (inclusive): counts and percentages per transaction type, total and average value, and a per-stock recap.

| Parameter | In | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `from` | query | String | yes |  | Tanggal awal periode (`YYYY-MM-DD`). |
| `to` | query | String | yes |  | Tanggal akhir periode (`YYYY-MM-DD`). Harus lebih besar atau sama dengan `from`. |

Returns: `JournalsSummaryResponse`.

| `code` | path | &str | yes |  | Kode saham untuk menampilkan postingan pada ruang diskusi saham tersebut. |
| `category` | path | PostsListByStockCategoryCategory: `Post` = `POST`, `Article` = `ARTICLE`, `Video` = `VIDEO`, `Stockpick` = `STOCKPICK`, `Polling` = `POLLING` | yes |  | Kategori postingan: `POST` = postingan umum, `ARTICLE` = artikel, `VIDEO` = video, `STOCKPICK` = rekomendasi saham, `POLLING` = polling. |
| `page` | query | i64 | yes |  | Nomor halaman, dimulai dari 1. |
| `limit` | query | i64 | yes |  | Jumlah postingan per halaman. |

Returns: `PostsListByStockCategoryResponse`.

## trades

Personal realized trades.

### `list`

**Realized Trade List** — `GET /trades` · cache: `default`

```rust
client.trades().list(params: &TradesListParams).await -> Result<Vec<TradesListItem>, InvezgoError>
```

Get the user's realized trades (from SELL journal entries) with a sell date between `from` and `to` (inclusive), newest first.

| Parameter | In | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `from` | query | String | yes |  | Tanggal awal periode (`YYYY-MM-DD`). |
| `to` | query | String | yes |  | Tanggal akhir periode (`YYYY-MM-DD`). Harus lebih besar atau sama dengan `from`. |

Returns: `Vec<TradesListItem>`.

### `delete`

**Delete Realized Trades** — `DELETE /trades` · cache: `none`

```rust
client.trades().delete(body: &DeleteIdsRequest).await -> Result<TradesDeleteResponse, InvezgoError>
```

Delete one or more realized trades by ID (body `{"id": ["<id>", ...]}`). Only the realized-trade records are removed; journal transactions and the portfolio are unchanged.

Body: `DeleteIdsRequest`. Returns: `TradesDeleteResponse`.

### `get_summary`

**Realized Trade Summary** — `GET /trades/summary` · cache: `default`

```rust
client.trades().get_summary(params: &TradesSummaryParams).await -> Result<TradesSummaryResponse, InvezgoError>
```

Get a performance summary of the user's realized trades with a sell date between `from` and `to` (inclusive): profit/loss/BEP counts, totals, win rate, and the best and worst trades.

| Parameter | In | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `from` | query | String | yes |  | Tanggal awal periode (`YYYY-MM-DD`). |
| `to` | query | String | yes |  | Tanggal akhir periode (`YYYY-MM-DD`). Harus lebih besar atau sama dengan `from`. |

Returns: `TradesSummaryResponse`.

### `get_summary_chart`

**Realized Trade Summary Chart** — `GET /trades/summary-chart` · cache: `default`

```rust
client.trades().get_summary_chart(params: &TradesSummaryChartParams).await -> Result<Vec<TradesSummaryChartItem>, InvezgoError>
```

Get daily chart data of the user's realized profit/loss with a sell date between `from` and `to` (inclusive), with its running total and the comparison index close on the same day. Only days with realized trades are returned, in ascending date order.

| Parameter | In | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `from` | query | String | yes |  | Tanggal awal periode (`YYYY-MM-DD`). |
| `to` | query | String | yes |  | Tanggal akhir periode (`YYYY-MM-DD`). Harus lebih besar atau sama dengan `from`. |
| `code` | query | String | yes |  | Kode indeks pembanding pada grafik, mis. `COMPOSITE`. Bila dikirim kosong (`code=`), setiap tanggal berisi satu baris per indeks. |

Returns: `Vec<TradesSummaryChartItem>`.

### `update_note`

**Update Realized Trade Note** — `PATCH /trades/{id}` · cache: `none`

```rust
client.trades().update_note(id: &str, body: &NoteTradeRequest).await -> Result<TradesUpdateNoteResponse, InvezgoError>
```

Update the note of one of the user's realized trades. Body: `{"note": "..."}` (optional, max 150 characters); when `note` is omitted the note is cleared.

| Parameter | In | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `id` | path | &str | yes |  | ID transaksi terealisasi, diambil dari field `id` pada response `GET /trades`. |

Body: `NoteTradeRequest`. Returns: `TradesUpdateNoteResponse`.
